what: Under Lean 4.35.0 and Mathlib v4.35.0, lake warns on every non-module file that imports Mathlib (Mathlib sets requiresModuleSystem): `BlazeDiff/Expr.lean: imports Mathlib ... consider adding module`. Adding `module` is not possible file by file: Lean refuses `cannot import non-module X from module`, and Expr.lean imports Blaze.Scalar (lean/) and BlazeDiff.Ops (generated by diff_rules.rs).
cost: the last own-file warning cannot be removed within a proof-scripts-only bump
cause: lean/, lean/analysis and the diff_rules.rs generator all write non-module files while Mathlib now requires the module system of its importers
workaround: `allowNonModules = true` under [[lean_lib]] BlazeDiff removes the warning (tested); the end state is `module` headers across lean/, lean/analysis and the generator output
